description: 一个空心盒子，顶面开口，壁厚2mm
description_en: A hollow box with open top and 2mm wall thickness
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
width = 100       # 宽度 (mm)
height = 60       # 高度 (mm)
depth = 40        # 深度 (mm)
wall_thickness = 2  # 壁厚 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(width, height, depth)
    .faces(">Z")
    .shell(-wall_thickness)
)

show_object(result)
